digest.component_or_area: binding store and rich-emission state routing
propositions: Production rich-emission state mutation currently bypasses the narrow facade accessor and instead mutates bindings reached through all_bindings() in apply_handlers._observe_rich_reemit

The docstring at _observe_rich_reemit falsely claims binding_store.py sits at module-size cap and cannot carry a narrower accessor, when S2 T3 added exactly such an accessor and the file is no longer at capacity
Production code path must route through BindingStore.note_rich_emit() authoritative facade instead of direct mutation while preserving hashes, counters, fail-open behavior, and logs identically
ADR 0099 lacks finalized recovery boundary, reversal rules, and explicit documentation of the realized invocation site and its staleness gate precondition
A census test must prevent any future production module from mutating bindings through all_bindings() while allowing legitimate read-only callers
